messages.text: BL-1645 🎵 in progress — A completion gate's evidence window opens when the inbound was created, not when it was dequeued: the Work-note gate (BL-1422/BL-1614) and the forward gate (BL-1609) count a commit or handoff naming the ticket from the inbound's created_at, so work done between a dispatch and its (re-)dequeue completes plainly instead of being refused both ways - the coder was stuck on BL-1637's Work note on 2026-09-19 with the work forwarded and live at the cleaner
